messages.en:
{07 00 00}It's your birthday today,
isn't it, {04 1f 00}?

{07 14 00}Hee hee!{01 00 00 05 00} You didn't think
I'd forget, did you? I wrote
it down and everything!
Today is a very important
day, the day my dearest
friend came into the world!
Here, I even brought you a
present, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Sul on täna sünnipäev,
kas pole, {04 1f 00}?

{07 14 00}Hii hii!{01 00 00 05 00} Sa ei arvanud, et
ma unustan, ega? Ma panin
selle kirja ja kõike!
Täna on väga tähtis päev,
päev, mil mu kalleim
sõber maailma tuli!
Säh, ma tõin sulle isegi
kingituse, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Happy birthday! So,
{04 1f 00}, you like it,
right, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 0a 00}I'm so happy! {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00}I hope you
and I stay friends for a
long, long time!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Palju õnne! Nii,
{04 1f 00}, sulle meeldib,
eks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 0a 00}Ma olen nii õnnelik! {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00}Loodan,
et sina ja mina oleme
kaua sõbrad!

{07 14 00}panid ka oma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
Loodan, et see meeldib!
